title: Tangential and Normal Components of Acceleration
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Orthogonal Decomposition of Acceleration
definitions.statement: The acceleration vector of a moving particle always lies entirely in the osculating plane spanned by T and N (its binormal component is identically zero). The tangential component a_T changes speed, while the normal component a_N changes direction.
definitions.explanation: Scalar formulas: a_T = (v . a)/|v| and a_N = |v x a|/|v| = sqrt(|a|^2 - a_T^2).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Disentangles rate of speed change from rate of directional curvature.

definitions.title: Osculating Plane
definitions.statement: The osculating plane at point r_0 on a smooth curve is the plane determined by the unit tangent T and principal normal N. It is the plane that has the closest contact with the curve at that point.
definitions.explanation: Has normal vector B = T x N. Contains both the velocity vector v and the acceleration vector a.
definitions.keyTakeaway: All instantaneous physical acceleration occurs within the osculating plane.
